dialog.close.description: The button at the end of the head of a confirmation (a small dialog that asks before something that cannot be undone), after its title, that closes it without confirming, as its Cancel does.

dialog.type_to_confirm.defaultMessage: 確認のため {phrase} と入力してください
dialog.type_to_confirm.description: The label of the field in a confirmation before something grave that cannot be undone (banning an account, closing the server, deleting a role): the confirmation stays disabled until the reader types the text. phrase is that text, shown in a code face (an account's handle such as spam_bot@social.example, the server's domain, a role's name).
